premise: I co‑signed a $200,000 home‑equity loan so my son‑in‑law could open an auto‑repair shop, and when he defaulted the bank took my house while he vanished; I tracked him through a luxury car he’d bought with embezzled shop funds, won a judgment, and now run ‘Lien of Lies Auto Care’ where he changes oil in a jumpsuit that says ‘Dipstick of Deceit’ and every oil‑change sticker prints his fraud‑docket number.
